title: SyntexLabs | BanSystem
body:
## SyntexLabs BanSystem

![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ffc091c145ee6e463971418798c0dd79b0d445ce.png)

**BanSystem** is a modern punishment and moderation plugin designed for Minecraft servers that need a fast, reliable, and fully optimized management system.
The plugin is built with performance in mind, ensuring smooth operation even on low-end servers while still providing powerful moderation tools for staff teams.

Make sure to join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/NN6Eg2JrES) server if any bugs or issues occur.

The plugin is **fully configurable** and allows you to **customize messages**, **punishment formats**, **prefixes**, and more.

The Plugin comes with the following commands and permissions bound to them:

![permissions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bafa5aa4a36dbf8dd08b470cf7042fe21a0761e2.png)

### 🔨 Permanent & Temporary Bans

Ban players permanently or temporarily with fully customizable reasons and durations. Temporary punishments expire automatically without requiring staff interaction.

### 🔇 Mute System

Mute players permanently or for a limited duration. Perfect for handling chat violations without removing players from the server entirely.

### ⚠️ Warning System

Issue warnings to players and track active warns directly in-game. Great for progressive moderation systems before harsher punishments are applied.

### 📜 Punishment History

Staff members can access a player's complete punishment history at any time, including bans, mutes, warnings, and kicks.

### 👢 Kick Command

Instantly remove disruptive players from the server with custom kick reasons.

### 📋 Ban List

View all currently active bans directly in-game through a clean and organized command output.

### ⚡ High Performance

BanSystem is optimized for minimal resource usage. Data is cached efficiently, managers clean themselves automatically, and the plugin avoids unnecessary overhead during normal operation.

### 🛡️ Staff Friendly

Every moderation tool is designed to be simple, fast, and intuitive so staff members can react quickly without complicated commands or menus.

### 🎨 Fully Customizable

Configure prefixes, punishment messages, layouts, and formatting to perfectly match your server's style and branding.

### 🔒 Secure Data Handling

Punishment data is safely managed and structured to ensure reliability and consistency across all moderation actions.

## Performance

SyntexBanSystem is built with performance as a core principle.
Punishment managers are optimized for fast lookups, player data is handled efficiently, and unnecessary processing is avoided entirely during regular gameplay.

The plugin is designed to have virtually zero impact on server performance while still offering advanced moderation functionality for professional server environments.

## Requirements

Minecraft: **1.21+**
Java: **21+**
Server Software: **Paper / Spigot**
